checks.name: Fresh catalog seeds four builtin native Skills and initialization is idempotent
Builtin source is immutable to edit/archive; turning off is revisioned
Explicit folder import preserves source and scripts as local bytes; it is disabled regardless of frontmatter
Duplicate active names and builtin collisions reject without overwriting catalog or sources
Enable produces a verified native descriptor without changing original metadata or source bytes
Stale edits and renaming cannot overwrite the current version
Editing writes a new immutable version, copies references, resets enabled, and preserves prior/original bytes
Local manager and main idle guard reject concurrent/active mutations
Changed registered reference fails preview/enable; disable and archive still succeed without rewriting source
Explicit reimport of archived custom package increments version and remains disabled
Reopen persists revisions/files/enabled states and native metadata
Missing teacher instruction is not recreated, and external source is never a fallback grant
No implicit subfolder/neighbor discovery and invalid native metadata/name/UTF-8 reject
SKILL/file/count/total/depth/empty-directory bounds reject before metadata publication
Directory junction inside package and symlink ancestor refuse; outside bytes are untouched
Windows-invalid and case-colliding stored paths, duplicate names and extra grants reject
Two independent state writers with same CAS revision have exactly one winner
Future schema and malformed persisted metadata cannot be read or overwritten
Persisted metadata cannot replace builtin reviewed bytes or relabel teacher package as builtin
CAS-lost copied version is inert and never auto-discovered
Source modified during version copy rejects publication and preserves both source and existing catalog
Failed fresh-version write remains unpublished; retry creates its own valid version without deleting source
Catalog capacity and runtime payload do not grant executable or file-write tools
Old DB copy gains only idempotent metadata table and preserves business/memory/public history
Current session state reads legacy bindings and exposes the integrated metadata adapter

boundaries: Catalog tests only; management IPC/UI/provider acceptance not covered by this suite
Actual SQLite/files and Pi parser, synthetic teacher packages; no provider calls
Explicit disposable old DB copy; source/business facts are read-only
